newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Hamon IPO to run from June 9 to 20.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Hamon IPO to run from June 9 to 20.

text.p: Belgian Hamon & Cie SA, a producer of cooling systems and heat exchangers for power plants, will offer 325,000 shares on the Brussels bourse between June 9 and 20 at a price between 2,050 to 2,280 francs.
The final price of the new shares, with a VVPR strip attached, will be fixed on June 12, the prospectus of the issue said.
The issue is arranged by Paribas Bank Belgium in cooperation with Generale Bank.
